name: protected-policy-confirmation-v1
candidate: Frozen seven-family familiar-policy classifier with retained development sigmoid; original Qwen centroid and identity calibration for unseen policies
reference: Frozen lexical reference fitted on the same 11135 development rows
primary_metric: Equal-weight mean of the six policy ROC AUCs on all eligible rows
primary_comparison: candidate minus lexical reference; one confirmatory contrast

bootstrap.method: paired empirical group bootstrap with tie-exact weighted per-policy AUC

acceptance.decision: All checks must pass; a failure blocks candidate promotion

diagnostics: six per-policy AUCs and class counts
familiar and unseen route macro AUC, log loss and Brier
with versus without self-support matches, if present
prediction_freeze: Commit source/configuration/model/input identity and prediction-file SHA-256 before interpreting any reserved target; record the Git commit in an immutable local access receipt
target_access: Verify pinned solution digest without displaying content; stream row_id first and interpret only frozen eligible labels; verify rule and Usage against the pre-existing boundary assignment
prohibited: refitting features, classifiers or calibrators on reserve
changing eligibility, acceptance thresholds or candidate after reserve access
selecting a winner among descriptive controls
Kaggle submission or a real submission CSV
failure_policy: Publish the failed fixed confirmation and limitations; no replacement model is independently confirmed on this reserve
scope: One post-competition confirmation conditional on six observed policies, including two excluded from development; not a leaderboard score or evidence over arbitrary future policies
